[USER] User is looking for new yoga routines to try at home.  
[USER] User wants to target core strength with yoga poses or flows.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Core strength is essential for good posture, balance, and overall stability in yoga.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended individual poses for core strength:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Plank Pose (Phalakasana): Engages entire core, including abs, obliques, and lower back. Hold for 30-60 seconds.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Boat Pose (Paripurna Navasana): Strengthens abs, obliques, and lower back. Hold for 30-60 seconds.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Side Plank Pose (Vasisthasana): Targets obliques and lower back. Hold for 30-60 seconds on each side.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Tree Pose (Vrksasana): Engages core and improves balance. Hold for 30-60 seconds on each leg.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Cobra Pose (Bhujangasana): Strengthens back muscles and engages core. Hold for 30 seconds.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended flows for core strength:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Sun Salutations with a Twist: Incorporate a rotation in Plank Pose to target the obliques.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Core Strength Flow: Start in Plank Pose, lift opposite arm and leg, repeat for 30-60 seconds.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Dynamic Boat Pose Flow: In Boat Pose, twist torso side to side for 30-60 seconds.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for core strength: Engage core by drawing navel towards spine, keep shoulders down, breathe naturally, listen to body, and practice regularly.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Remember to warm up before starting any yoga practice and cool down afterwards to prevent injuries.
